card.name: Linking words in art and media prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs (such as contain, at, from, by, perceive) in general prose about art, images, film or science, where the next word is open. It is not tied to any single word.

modes.label: Linking words in art history
modes.description: Prepositions and verbs inside sentences about painting media, slides, or images from ads.
modes.example: the kind that usually<< contain>> microscopic samples of bacteria or chemicals.

modes.label: Instructions and course text
modes.description: Words in how-to or course-description sentences, such as multiplying by a value or how people perceive faces.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about writing, text and readers (Chinese and English) and away from words for pianos, paintings and film.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in explanatory prose, mostly about art or images, and nudges the model toward writing-related words.
